title: Seshego Hospital substation, Seshego (approx.): switch stripped, cables damaged, about R500,000; police seek suspects, 11 Oct
summary: Police say essential electrical infrastructure at the Seshego Hospital substation on Bookelo Street, Seshego (Capricorn District), was tampered with. The damage was found on Sunday 11 October when a municipal electrician...
story: Police say essential electrical infrastructure at the Seshego Hospital substation on Bookelo Street, Seshego (Capricorn District), was tampered with. The damage was found on Sunday 11 October when a municipal electrician responded at about 17:00 to a complaint about a power supply problem at the hospital. He found the substation doors open and a school bag with a side cutter, a knife and electrical wire inside. A switch had been stripped and damaged, and high-voltage cables and the distribution board were also damaged; the damage is estimated at R500,000. No arrests have been made; police have launched a manhunt for unknown suspects (police statement, published by Review Online on 14 October, with Limpopo Provincial Commissioner Lt-Gen Jan Scheepers quoted). When the tampering happened is not stated; the date is the day it was found. One report, resting on police. The pin is approximate: the hospital point, not the substation itself.
